title: Management shapes sustainable aquaculture across environmental and social outcomes
abstract: As global aquaculture production continues to increase rapidly, there is growing interest in strengthening aquaculture’s performance across multiple sustainability dimensions. However, there has been limited effort to understand the link between different governance factors and the multiple objectives of sustainability, as well as the relative importance of different factors. We analyze a global dataset of 69 aquaculture systems using regression tree and random forest analysis to shed light on how the multiple sustainability dimensions relate to management and other enabling factors. We find that many factors are cross-cutting and contribute to performance in more than one pillar of sustainability. Aquaculture management is a cross-cutting factor that contributes to all three pillars of sustainability and is the most important factor contributing to environmental and social dimensions. The results show that factors not explicit to aquaculture, such as the broader governance and economic conditions, are also important to all three pillars. Achieving sustainable aquaculture was associated with additional elements such as research and development, infrastructure and management inputs. Infrastructure generally supports sustainable development, but without sufficiently strong management, infrastructure investments were associated with weaker environmental outcomes. The results suggest policy makers use multi-faceted approaches to achieve the multiple objectives of aquaculture development. Aquaculture management is the strongest driver of sustainability, but governance, R&D, and infrastructure also matter, and without strong management, infrastructure can undermine environmental outcomes, according to regression tree and random forest analyses of 69 aquaculture systems.
abstract_zh: 随着全球水产养殖产量持续快速增长，人们越来越关注加强水产养殖在多个可持续性维度上的表现。然而，人们对于不同治理因素与可持续性多重目标之间的联系，以及各类因素的相对重要性，所做的努力仍然有限。我们使用回归树和随机森林分析了一个包含69个水产养殖系统的全球数据集，以揭示多个可持续性维度与管理及其他支持性因素之间的关系。我们发现，许多因素具有交叉性，对可持续性三大支柱中的不止一个都有贡献。水产养殖管理是一个交叉性因素，它对可持续性的三大支柱都有贡献，并且是对环境和社会维度最重要的因素。结果表明，并非专属于水产养殖的因素（如更广泛的治理和经济条件）对三大支柱同样重要。实现可持续水产养殖还与研发、基础设施和管理投入等其他要素相关。基础设施通常有助于可持续发展，但若缺乏足够强有力的管理，基础设施投资则与较弱的环境结果相关。研究结果表明，政策制定者应采取多层面的方法，以实现水产养殖发展的多重目标。管理是可持续性最强的驱动因素，但治理、研发和基础设施同样重要；若缺乏强有力的管理，基础设施可能破坏环境结果。（基于对69个水产养殖系统的回归树与随机森林分析）

title: A Review of Global Fisheries Performance
abstract: Management of fisheries is complex as it combines environmental, economic and social objectives. The relative importance of these objectives is highly debated and the best approaches to achieving good outcomes are unclear. A lack of global and multi‐dimensional data has largely precluded reviews providing comparisons of performances across systems at a large scale. We review fisheries performance by analysing outcomes over 14 dimensions of environmental, economic and community performance using a unique global dataset for 145 fisheries collected with the Fishery Performance Indicators. The fisheries are ranked into three performance groups by an average of their environmental, economic and community scores: the 10% best fisheries, the 10% worst fisheries and the middle 80%. Furthermore, we investigate how four different types of management systems, catch shares, territorial use rights, limited entry and open access, are represented in the three performance groups. The best performing fisheries scored equally or better and the poorest performing fisheries scored equally or worse in environmental, economic and social dimensions. We found three different management systems to be represented among the best performing fisheries, indicating that no specific management system is best. Moreover, some management systems were represented in all three performance categories, indicating that fisheries characteristics or management designs are important elements of fishery performance. The worst performing fisheries were dominated by open access fisheries with no or very limited management.
abstract_zh: 渔业管理十分复杂，因为它同时兼顾环境、经济和社会目标。这些目标的相对重要性存在高度争议，实现良好结果的最佳途径也不明确。缺乏全球性的多维数据，在很大程度上使得大规模比较各系统绩效的综述难以开展。我们利用渔业绩效指标（Fishery Performance Indicators）所收集的145个渔业的独特全球数据集，通过分析14个环境、经济和社区绩效维度上的结果，回顾了渔业绩效。根据环境、经济和社区得分的平均值，这些渔业被划分为三个绩效组：最佳的10%渔业、最差的10%渔业，以及中间的80%。此外，我们考察了四种不同类型的管理制度——渔获份额制（catch shares）、领海使用权（territorial use rights）、限制准入（limited entry）和开放准入（open access）——在三个绩效组中的分布情况。表现最好的渔业在环境、经济和社会维度上的得分同样好或更好，而表现最差的渔业在这些维度上的得分同样差或更差。我们发现，三种不同的管理制度在表现最好的渔业中均有代表，表明没有某种特定的管理制度是最优的。此外，某些管理制度出现在全部三个绩效类别中，表明渔业特征或管理设计是渔业绩效的重要因素。表现最差的渔业以无管理或管理非常有限的开放准入渔业为主。

title: An analysis of China’s aquaculture sector for the three pillars of sustainability
abstract: China is the world’s largest aquaculture producer with a diverse sector in terms of species, technologies, and production environments. Production volume has grown substantially since the late 1970s, reaching 52.2 million metric tonnes in 2021. However, the Chinese aquaculture sector has also faced sustainability challenges. In this paper, we use the Aquaculture Performance Indicators to assess twelve important aquaculture systems in China and to analyze the sector’s overall performance and variations among different systems in terms of environmental, economic, and social sustainability. Among the three pillars of sustainability, environmental performance showed the highest variation among Chinese aquaculture systems. Oyster aquaculture outperformed the other systems in environmental and social sustainability, while carp aquaculture scored highest in economic sustainability. While there is a notable variation in the results by species, the Chinese aquaculture sector on average performed close to the global average in terms of triple bottoms of sustainability.
abstract_zh: 中国是世界上最大的水产养殖生产国，其养殖产业在物种、技术和生产环境方面都十分多样。自20世纪70年代末以来，产量大幅增长，2021年达到5220万公吨。然而，中国水产养殖业也面临着可持续性挑战。本文利用水产养殖绩效指标（Aquaculture Performance Indicators）评估了中国12个重要的水产养殖系统，并分析了该行业在环境、经济和社会可持续性方面的总体绩效以及各系统之间的差异。在可持续性三大支柱中，环境绩效在中国各水产养殖系统之间的差异最大。牡蛎养殖在环境和社会可持续性方面优于其他系统，而鲤鱼养殖在经济可持续性方面得分最高。虽然结果因物种而异十分显著，但就可持续性三重底线而言，中国水产养殖业的平均表现与全球平均水平接近。

title: Aquaculture in the United States: An analysis of seven aquaculture sectors from the aquaculture performance indicators perspective
Environmental impacts and food loss and waste in the U.S. aquatic food system
abstract: Aquatic food systems support global food and nutrition security, livelihoods, and economies, but put significant environmental pressure on the planet. The United States (U.S.) is the world’s fourth largest consumer and the largest importer of aquatic food, which makes it a good case for studying aquatic food systems. Here, we estimate the energy use, greenhouse gas emissions (GHGe) and blue water use by species, production method, product form, and stage of the U.S. supply chain, while accounting for trade and food loss and waste. We identified wide variation across species for energy use (40.2 to 259.1 MJ/kg), GHGe (3.7 to 22.2 kg CO2 eq/kg), and blue water use (15.8 to 1,851 l/kg). Capture fisheries and aquaculture on average used similar amounts of energy per unit of edible aquatic food; however, aquaculture emitted 54 % more GHGe and consumed 784 % more blue water than capture fisheries, due to the high GHGe and blue water intensity of aquaculture feed. Products with the lowest energy use were canned, fresh, and frozen sockeye salmon, frozen pollock, and frozen catfish. Products with the lowest GHGe were canned, fresh, and frozen sockeye salmon, frozen pollock, canned and frozen tuna, and frozen Atlantic salmon, All wild caught species had significantly lower blue water use impacts than farmed products. The production stage had the largest environmental impacts, but measuring production alone would miss 64 % of the energy, 36 % of the GHGe, and 21 % of the blue water used in the remainder of the supply chain. The processing stage was an important contributor to resource use for species with energy and water efficient production practices. Aquatic food in the U.S. supply is lost and wasted at an overall rate of 23 %; lost and wasted seafood contains 22 % to 24 % of the embodied energy, GHGe, and blue water in aquatic food systems. Compared to findings identified in the literature, aquatic foods in this study were lower in GHGe than beef, had a range of GHGe that extended above and below pork and poultry, and had higher GHGe than most legumes, and nuts. Estimating the environmental impacts and food loss and waste in the U.S. aquatic food system can help identify opportunities to enhance sustainability and resilience and support science communication about lower-impact foods and dietary patterns.
abstract_zh: 水产食品体系支撑着全球的粮食与营养安全、生计和经济，但也对地球施加了巨大的环境压力。美国是世界第四大水产食品消费国，也是最大的水产食品进口国，这使其成为研究水产食品体系的一个良好案例。在此，我们按物种、生产方式、产品形态以及美国供应链的各个阶段，估算了能源使用、温室气体排放（GHGe）和蓝水使用量，同时考虑了贸易以及食物损失与浪费。我们发现，各物种在能源使用（40.2至259.1 MJ/kg）、温室气体排放（3.7至22.2 kg CO₂当量/kg）和蓝水使用（15.8至1,851 L/kg）方面差异很大。捕捞渔业与水产养殖在每单位可食用水产食品上的平均能源消耗相近；然而，由于水产养殖饲料的温室气体强度和蓝水强度很高，水产养殖的温室气体排放比捕捞渔业高54%，蓝水消耗高出784%。能源使用最低的产品包括罐装、新鲜和冷冻的红鲑（sockeye salmon）、冷冻狭鳕（pollock）以及冷冻鲶鱼。温室气体排放最低的产品包括罐装、新鲜和冷冻的红鲑、冷冻狭鳕、罐装和冷冻金枪鱼以及冷冻大西洋鲑。所有野生捕获的物种，其蓝水使用的影响均显著低于养殖产品。生产阶段的环境影响最大，但如果只测算生产阶段，将遗漏供应链其余环节64%的能源、36%的温室气体排放和21%的蓝水使用。对于能源和水资源利用效率较高的物种，加工阶段是资源利用的重要贡献者。美国水产食品供应的总体损失与浪费率为23%；被损失和浪费的海产品所含的隐含能源、温室气体排放和蓝水，占水产食品体系的22%至24%。与文献中的发现相比，本研究中的水产食品的温室气体排放低于牛肉，其范围高于或低于猪肉与禽肉，并且高于大多数豆类和坚果。估算美国水产食品体系的环境影响及食物损失与浪费，有助于识别提升可持续性与韧性的机会，并支持关于低影响食品与饮食模式的科学传播。

title: From fjords to factories: The economics of international supply chains and processing of Norwegian Salmon exports
Indonesia: The Most Overlooked Country in the Global Seafood System
Introducing the aquaculture performance indicators: A tool to assess the triple bottomline in aquaculture systems
Special issue Introduction—Aquaculture performance indicators: A low-cost tool for comparison and evaluation of data-scarce aquaculture sectors around the world
Application of the food-energy-water nexus to six seafood supply chains: hearing from wild and farmed seafood supply chain actors in the United States, Norway, and Vietnam
abstract:
The food-energy-water (FEW) nexus highlights the interdependencies between the systems that people rely on for these essential resources. For example, globally, over two thirds of freshwater withdrawals are used to produce food, and another 10% is used during energy generation. In addition, the food system uses one eighth of global net energy. Seafood is a nutritionally important food, and it is critical to use freshwater and energy resources efficiently throughout seafood supply chains to safeguard future supplies and to reduce environmental impacts. Diverse seafood production methods result in highly variable resource use across supply chains, which may contribute to siloed efforts within supply chains to improve efficiency, instead of larger efforts that involve multiple seafood supply chains. Additionally, efforts to develop and implement efficiency strategies must be informed by fishers, aquaculturists, processors, and other seafood supply chain actors to avoid investing time and resources into strategies that will have low uptake. A significant proportion of seafood is imported into the U.S., so engaging with industry and stakeholders in the U.S. and abroad is critical for understanding and improving the FEW nexus associated with seafood consumed by Americans.
To understand how resources are being used, current and potential strategies to improve resource use, and relevant motivations and barriers, we conducted 47 semi-structured interviews from 2019 to 2021 with seafood supply chain actors, including producers and processors. Seafood supply chains included were farmed catfish produced in the U.S., farmed pangasius and shrimp produced in Vietnam, farmed Atlantic salmon produced in Norway, and wild-caught sockeye and pink salmon caught in the U.S.
We provide detailed descriptions of stages within each supply chain regarding resource use and efficiency strategies, and report higher-level findings that apply across supply chains. There was variation across settings regarding how resources are used and opportunities and barriers for improving efficiencies, but we also found commonalities in settings, indicating that resource-saving strategies or innovations could lead to increased efficiency across multiple supply chains. Interviewees shared that cost savings drove past adoption of, and high interest in, energy conservation practices. Generally, direct costs did not motivate reduced use of freshwater, but associated costs like energy to run pumps and supplies to treat contaminated surface water drove interest in reducing water use.
Efforts to improve resource use in the U.S. seafood supply should focus on identifying and scaling-up strategies that (i) involve improved efficiency of more than one resource and/or (ii) apply across multiple settings. This work should involve partnerships between industry, government agencies, and academic researchers, and should be informed by supply chain actors’ experiences and insights. The qualitative insights from this study encompass rich descriptions of FEW-relevant factors at the level of specific supply chain stages as well as findings across six major seafood supply chains in three countries. The study provides an essential complement to existing quantitative characterizations of resource use, and enables nuanced and informed responses to challenges.
abstract_zh:
食物—能源—水（FEW）关联凸显了人们赖以获取这些基本资源的各系统之间的相互依存关系。例如，在全球范围内，超过三分之二的淡水取水用于食物生产，另有10%用于能源发电。此外，食物体系消耗了全球净能源的八分之一。海产品是一种营养价值很高的食物，高效利用淡水与能源资源贯穿整个海产品供应链，对于保障未来供给、减少环境影响至关重要。多样化的海产品生产方式导致供应链之间的资源利用差异很大，这可能导致各供应链分别为提高效率而各自为政，而非开展涉及多个海产品供应链的更大规模努力。此外，提高效率策略的制定与实施，必须听取渔民、水产养殖者、加工者以及其他海产品供应链行为体的意见，以避免将时间和资源投入到采纳率低的策略中。美国大量海产品依赖进口，因此，与美国国内外的行业及利益相关者开展合作，对于理解并改善美国所消费海产品的FEW关联至关重要。
为了解资源是如何被使用的、当前及潜在的资源利用改进策略，以及相关动机与障碍，我们于2019年至2021年间对海产品供应链行为体（包括生产者和加工者）进行了47次半结构化访谈。所涵盖的海产品供应链包括：美国养殖的鲶鱼（farmed catfish）、越南养殖的巴沙鱼（pangasius）和虾、挪威养殖的大西洋鲑，以及美国捕获的野生红鲑与粉鲑。
我们详细描述了每条供应链各环节在资源使用和效率策略方面的情况，并报告了适用于各供应链的更高层面发现。各环境在资源如何被使用、以及改善效率的机会与障碍方面存在差异，但我们也发现了一些共性，表明资源节约策略或创新可能在多条供应链中提高效率。受访者表示，成本节约曾推动了过去对节能措施的采纳，并使其备受青睐。一般而言，直接成本并未促使人们减少淡水使用，但与之相关的成本（如驱动水泵的能源成本以及处理受污染地表水的用品成本）则推动了人们减少用水的兴趣。
美国海产品供应中资源利用的改善工作，应重点识别并推广以下策略：（i）能够提高多种资源效率的策略，和/或（ii）能够适用于多种环境的策略。这项工作应当依靠产业界、政府机构和学术研究人员之间的伙伴关系，并应以供应链行为体的经验与见解为依据。本研究的定性洞见，既包含对具体供应链环节中FEW相关因素的丰富描述，也涵盖了三个国家六大主要海产品供应链的综合发现。本研究为现有对资源利用的定量刻画提供了重要补充，并有助于对各类挑战作出细致且知情的应对。

title: Environmental, economic, and social sustainability in aquaculture: the aquaculture performance indicators
abstract: Aquaculture is a rapidly growing food production technology, but there are significant concerns related to its environmental impact and adverse social effects. We examine aquaculture outcomes in a three pillars of sustainability framework by analyzing data collected using the Aquaculture Performance Indicators. Using this approach, comparable data has been collected for 57 aquaculture systems worldwide on 88 metrics that measure social, economic, or environmental outcomes. We first examine the relationships among the three pillars of sustainability and then analyze performance in the three pillars by technology and species. The results show that economic, social, and environmental outcomes are, on average, mutually reinforced in global aquaculture systems. However, the analysis also shows significant variation in the degree of sustainability in different aquaculture systems, and weak performance of some production systems in some dimensions provides opportunity for innovative policy measures and investment to further align sustainability objectives.
abstract_zh: 水产养殖是一种快速增长的食品生产技术，但其环境影响与不利的社会效应备受关注。我们利用水产养殖绩效指标收集的数据，在环境、经济与社会三大支柱的框架下考察水产养殖的结果。通过这一方法，我们收集了全球57个水产养殖系统在88项指标上可比的数据，这些指标衡量社会、经济或环境结果。我们首先考察了可持续性三大支柱之间的关系，然后按技术和物种分析各支柱的绩效。结果显示，在全球水产养殖系统中，经济、社会和环境结果平均而言是相互促进的。然而，分析也表明，不同水产养殖系统的可持续性程度存在显著差异，部分生产系统在某些维度上表现欠佳，这为创新性的政策措施与投资，以进一步使可持续性目标相互协调提供了机会。

title: The economic contribution of U.S. seafood imports throughout the value chain: A sectorial and species-specific analysis
Aquatic food loss and waste rate in the United States is half of earlier estimates
Global and Regional Determinants of Diversity in Blue Foods
Perception shifts in seafood consumption in the United States
Aquaculture: The missing contributor in the food security agenda
China’s seafood imports—Not for domestic consumption?
Global insights on managing fishery systems for the three pillars of sustainability
abstract: There is growing recognition that fisheries should be managed for all three pillars of sustainability: economic, social and environmental sustainability. Limited quantitative evidence exists on factors supporting social sustainability, much less factors that contribute to multiple dimensions of sustainability. To develop a broader understanding of the factors that influence the performance of fishery management systems in environmental, economic and social pillars, we examine 11 input factors conjectured to contribute to successful fisheries using a global dataset of 145 fisheries case studies. The analysis indicates that management approaches are cross‐cutting and contribute to multiple dimensions of sustainability to varying extents. Importantly, factors exogenous to fisheries management can be as important as fisheries management, suggesting collaboration of fisheries institutions with other public and private institutions is important for sustainable fisheries development.
abstract_zh: 人们日益认识到，渔业应当同时兼顾可持续性的三大支柱：经济、社会和环境可持续性。关于支持社会可持续性因素的定量证据有限，而影响多个可持续性维度的因素就更少了。为深入理解影响渔业管理体系在环境、经济和社会三大支柱上表现的因素，我们利用一个包含145个渔业案例的全球数据集，考察了11个被推测有助于渔业成功的投入因素。分析表明，管理方式具有跨领域的性质，并在不同程度上促进了多个可持续性维度。重要的是，渔业管理之外的因素可能与渔业管理同样重要，这表明渔业机构与其他公共和私人机构的合作对于可持续渔业发展至关重要。

title: Identifying Opportunities for Aligning Production and Consumption in the U.S. Fisheries by Considering Seasonality
abstract: Seasonality is a natural feature of wild caught fisheries that introduces variation in food supply, and which often is amplified by fisheries management systems. Seasonal timing of landings patterns and linkages to consumption patterns can have a potentially strong impact on income for coastal communities as well as import patterns. This study characterizes the relationship between seasonality in seafood production and consumption in the United States by analyzing monthly domestic fisheries landings and imports and retail sales of farmed and wild seafood from 2017 to 2019. Analyses were conducted for total seafood sales, by product form, by species group, and by region of the United States. The data reveal strong seasonal increases in consumption around December and March. Seasonal increases in consumption in Spring and Summer occurred in parallel with domestic fishing production. Domestic landings vary by region, but most regions have peak fishing seasons between May and October. Alaska has the largest commercial fishery in the United States and seasonal peaks in Alaska (July/August, February/March) strongly influence seasonality in national landings. Misalignment between domestic production and consumption in some seasons and species groups creates opportunities for imports to supplement demand and lost opportunities for domestic producers.
abstract_zh: 季节性是野生捕捞渔业的自然特征，它造成了食物供应的波动，而渔业管理体系往往又会放大这种波动。渔获量的季节性时间模式及其与消费模式的联系，可能对沿海社区的收入以及进口模式产生潜在的强烈影响。本研究通过分析2017年至2019年美国国内渔业的月度渔获量与进口量，以及养殖和野生海产品的零售销售额，刻画了美国海产品生产与消费之间季节性的关系。分析按海产品总销售额、产品形态、物种类别以及美国地区分别进行。数据显示，消费在12月和3月前后出现了明显的季节性增长。春季和夏季的季节性消费增长，与国内捕捞产量同步出现。国内渔获量因地区而异，但大多数地区的捕捞旺季集中在5月至10月。阿拉斯加拥有美国最大的商业渔业，其季节性高峰（7/8月、2/3月）强烈影响着全国渔获量的季节性。在某些季节和物种类别中，国内生产与消费之间的错位，为进口补充需求以及国内生产者丧失机会创造了条件。

title: Market incentives for shark fisheries
abstract: Fishers tend to prioritize landings of the most valuable product to better utilize vessel capacity. This may lead to discards of catches that are economically undesirable or legally prohibited. The high-value of shark fins and the low-value of shark carcasses has traditionally led to an example of that practice, known as finning. Brazil is an important player in the trade for non-fin shark products. The recent increase in shark meat trade is associated with increased imports of shark meat in Brazil. This increase may be a consequence of stricter finning regulations that has created incentives for full utilization of sharks and exposed the resource to a new source of demand. Thus, sharks overexploitation may increase, even if demand for fins weakens over time. This paper investigates the shark meat market development in Brazil over the last decades using demand and cointegration analysis, with a focus on before and after implementation of finning restrictions in 1998. Results indicate that shark meat is not a new market in Brazil, but an old one driven by a particular interest from local consumers. The decline in domestic shark meat landings, increasing demand for seafood, and the commoditization of shark meat have facilitated import growth. Additionally, domestic prices seem to influence imports most likely because Brazil is an important player as a shark meat consumer. This means that even with the global shark fin market weakening, the Brazilian demand for shark meat is likely to contribute to the overexploitation of sharks in poorly managed fisheries.
abstract_zh: 渔民倾向于优先上岸价值最高的产品，以便更好地利用船只的运力。这可能导致在经济上不受欢迎或在法律上被禁止的渔获物被丢弃。鲨鱼鳍价值高而鲨鱼躯体价值低，传统上这造成了一种被称为“割鳍”（finning）的典型做法。巴西是非鳍类鲨鱼产品贸易中的重要参与者。近期鲨鱼肉贸易的增加，与巴西鲨鱼肉进口的增加相关联。这种增长可能是更严格的割鳍管制所带来的结果，此类管制促使人们充分利用鲨鱼，并使该资源面临新的需求来源。因此，即使鲨鱼鳍需求随时间减弱，鲨鱼的过度捕捞仍可能加剧。本文利用需求分析与协整分析，考察了巴西过去几十年鲨鱼肉市场的发展，重点关注1998年实施割鳍限制前后的情况。结果表明，鲨鱼肉在巴西并非新市场，而是一个老市场，其需求由当地消费者的特殊兴趣所驱动。国内鲨鱼肉渔获量的下降、海产品需求的增长以及鲨鱼肉的商品化，促进了进口的增长。此外，国内价格似乎会影响进口，很可能是因为巴西作为鲨鱼肉消费国具有重要地位。这意味着，即使全球鲨鱼鳍市场走弱，巴西对鲨鱼肉的需求仍可能导致管理不善的渔业中鲨鱼遭到过度捕捞。

title: Regulating menu information: What do consumers care and not care about at casual and fine dining restaurants for seafood consumption?
Renewable energy in fisheries and aquaculture: Case studies from the United States
abstract: Fisheries and aquaculture are highly reliant on fossil fuels and must transition to renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and meet global planetary heath goals. Here, we assessed total and renewable energy use in farmed catfish and wild-caught salmon, two of the largest seafood sectors in the United States (U.S.). Interviews were used to explore participants’ views of key barriers and opportunities to replace fossil fuel use. Modeled scenarios were used to assess changes in grid source energy and electricity costs for the farmed catfish sector using the U.S. EIA National Energy Modeling System. We found that renewable energy makes up 5% of direct energy use in catfish aquaculture in Mississippi and Alabama. Catfish industry interviewees indicate that cheap electricity costs and diurnal energy use are barriers to onsite implementation of renewables. Projected renewable energy use for the catfish sector could be as high as 41% of total direct energy use in 2050 under modeled scenarios, which would result in 86% lower CO2 emissions but 34% higher electricity costs. For wild-capture pink salmon from Prince William Sound, Alaska (AK) and sockeye salmon from Bristol Bay, AK, renewable energy makes up 2% and 0% of direct energy use, respectively. Wild-caught salmon industry interviewees identified the short duration of the fishing season as a barrier for onsite renewable energy, though there is a desire for more regional renewable energy technologies to lower electricity costs and increase reliability. Proposed renewable energy projects at utilities in fish processing towns in AK would only make modest improvements in the share of direct energy from renewables due to fuel use by fishing vessels. This is the first study to characterize current and potential renewable energy use among parts of the fisheries and aquaculture sectors in the U.S. We found that energy needs for fisheries and aquaculture are influenced by their often-remote location, production methods, and seasonal energy demands, which require context-specific solutions. There is the need for federal and state policies and incentives to shift energy sources used in these sectors to meet national and international climate change goals while supporting food security.
abstract_zh: 渔业与水产养殖高度依赖化石燃料，必须向可再生能源转型，以减少碳排放并实现全球星球健康目标。在此，我们评估了美国两大海产品部门——养殖鲶鱼和野生捕获鲑鱼——的总能源与可再生能源使用情况。我们通过访谈探讨了参与者对替代化石燃料使用的主要障碍与机遇的看法。我们利用美国能源信息署（EIA）的国家能源建模系统（NEMS）构建了情景模型，以评估养殖鲶鱼部门电网来源能源和电费的变化。我们发现，在密西西比州和阿拉巴马州，可再生能源占鲶鱼养殖直接能源使用的5%。鲶鱼行业的受访者指出，廉价的电费以及昼夜能源使用的规律是现场实施可再生能源的障碍。在模型情景下，到2050年，鲶鱼部门的可再生能源使用量可能高达直接能源使用总量的41%，这将使二氧化碳排放降低86%，但电费将上涨34%。对于来自阿拉斯加威廉王子湾的野生粉鲑和阿拉斯加布里斯托尔湾的红鲑，可再生能源分别占直接能源使用的2%和0%。野生鲑鱼行业的受访者指出，渔季时间短是现场实施可再生能源的障碍，尽管人们希望有更多区域性可再生能源技术，以降低电费并提高可靠性。阿拉斯加海产品加工城镇公用事业公司拟议的可再生能源项目，由于渔船的燃料使用，只能对直接能源中可再生能源的份额作出适度改善。这是首次对美国渔业与水产养殖部分环节当前及潜在可再生能源使用进行刻画的研究。我们发现，渔业与水产养殖的能源需求受其通常所处偏远位置、生产方式和季节性能源需求的影响，需要因地制宜的解决方案。为了在支持粮食安全的同时实现国家和国际气候变化目标，有必要通过联邦和州政府的政策与激励措施，推动这些部门转向其他能源来源。

Market potential for Gulf of Mexico farm-raised finfish
abstract: Concerns that additional supplies of U.S. farm-raised fish may compete with domestic wild fish has contributed to resistance and litigation that has slowed aquaculture development in the U.S. We employ a contingent choice experiment to large seafood wholesalers and suppliers in the U.S. to investigate market potential of new farmed finfish species from the Gulf of Mexico. We estimate probabilities that wholesale buyers prefer a new farmed product over existing market products using a conditional logit model. The results indicate it is more probable that Gulf farmed fish will substitute for imports than for domestic wild-caught fish given U.S. wholesale buyers have a preference for domestic fish to imported fish, but no significant preference for wild-caught fish to farmed fish.
abstract_zh: 人们担心美国养殖鱼类的额外供应可能与国内野生鱼类竞争，这已引发抵制和诉讼，并延缓了美国水产养殖的发展。我们向美国大型海产品批发商和供应商开展了一项或有选择实验（contingent choice experiment），以考察墨西哥湾新型养殖鳍鱼物种的市场潜力。我们使用条件Logit模型，估计了批发买家更偏好新养殖产品而非现有市场产品的概率。结果表明，墨西哥湾养殖鱼类更可能替代进口产品，而非国内野生捕获的鱼类，因为美国批发买家偏好国产鱼而非进口鱼，但对野生捕获鱼与养殖鱼之间并无显著偏好。

title: The fishery performance indicators for global tuna fisheries
abstract: We characterize the ecological, economic, and community performance of 21 major tuna fisheries, accounting for at least 77% of global tuna production, using the Fishery Performance Indicators. Our analysis reveals that the biggest variations in performance among tuna fisheries are driven by the final markets that they target: international sashimi market tuna fisheries considerably outperform a comparison set of 62 non-tuna fisheries in the Fishery Performance Indicator database, international canned tuna market fisheries perform similarly to the comparison set, and tuna fisheries supplying local markets in coastal states considerably underperform the comparison set. Differences among regional fishery management organizations primarily reflect regional species composition and market access, despite stark variation in governance, management, and other enabling conditions. With a legacy of open access, tuna’s harvest sector performance is similar across all fisheries, reflecting only a normal return on the capital and skill invested: industrial vessels slightly outperform semi-industrial and artisanal vessels. Differences emerge in the post-harvest sector however, as value chains able to preserve quality and transport fish to high value markets outperform others.
abstract_zh: 我们利用渔业绩效指标，刻画了21个主要金枪鱼渔业的生态、经济和社区绩效，这些渔业占全球金枪鱼产量的至少77%。分析表明，金枪鱼渔业之间绩效差异最大的原因，在于它们所面向的最终市场：面向国际生鱼片市场的金枪鱼渔业显著优于渔业绩效指标数据库中62个非金枪鱼渔业的对照组；面向国际罐头市场的金枪鱼渔业与对照组表现相近；而供应沿海国家当地市场的金枪鱼渔业则显著低于对照组。区域渔业管理组织之间的差异主要反映了区域物种构成和市场准入，尽管治理、管理和其他支持条件存在显著差异。由于长期处于开放准入状态，金枪鱼的捕捞部门在所有渔业中绩效相似，仅反映了对所投入资本和技能的正常回报：工业化船只的表现略优于半工业化和手工船只。然而，在捕后部门出现了差异：能够保持质量并将鱼运输至高价值市场的价值链，表现优于其他价值链。

title: Are fishery management upgrades worth the cost?
abstract: Many analyses of fishery recovery have demonstrated the potential biological and economic benefits of management reform, but few have compared these to the associated costs of management upgrades, which can be substantial. This study aims to determine if the projected economic benefits of management reform outweigh the increases in management costs required to achieve those benefits. To answer this question, we developed a database of country-level fisheries management costs and use those to estimate the country-level costs of management changes. We use this framework to compare estimates of future costs of management upgrades against their economic benefits in terms of profit. Results indicate that for most nations, including the top 25 fishing nations, management upgrades outweigh their associated costs. This result is robust to a number of alternative assumptions about costs. Results also suggest that stronger reforms such as rights-based management, although sometimes more expensive to implement, can lead to greater net economic benefits compared to alternatives.
abstract_zh: 许多对渔业恢复的分析已经证明了管理改革潜在的生物和经济效益，但很少有研究将这些效益与管理升级的相关成本进行比较，而这些成本可能十分高昂。本研究旨在判断，管理改革的预期经济效益是否超过实现这些效益所需增加的管理成本。为回答这一问题，我们建立了一个国家层面渔业管理成本数据库，并用其估计管理变革的国家层面成本。我们运用该框架，将管理升级的未来成本估计与其在利润方面的经济效益进行比较。结果表明，对大多数国家（包括排名前25位的主要捕捞国）而言，管理升级的收益超过其相关成本。该结论对关于成本的多种替代性假设都是稳健的。结果还表明，诸如权利基础管理等更强有力的改革，尽管实施成本有时更高，但与其他替代方案相比，可以带来更大的净经济效益。

title: Three pillars of sustainability in fisheries
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The United Nations proclaims that sustainable development comprises environmental, economic, and social sustainability. Fisheries contribute to livelihoods, food security, and human health worldwide; however, as the planet’s last major hunting and gathering industry, whether, and if so, how fishing can achieve all three pillars of sustainability is unclear. The relationships between environmental and economic sustainability, as well as between economic and social sustainability, continue to receive attention. We analyzed data from 121 fisheries worldwide to evaluate potential trade-offs. We found no evidence of trade-offs, and instead found that environmental, economic, and social objectives are complementary when fisheries are managed. Our results challenge the idea that the three pillars of sustainability are in conflict, suggesting that rights-based systems can be designed to support all three pillars.
abstract_zh: 联合国宣称，可持续发展包括环境、经济和社会三个维度的可持续性。渔业为全球生计、粮食安全和人类健康作出贡献；然而，作为地球上最后一个主要的狩猎采集产业，捕捞能否实现三大可持续性支柱，若能，又该如何实现，目前仍不清楚。环境可持续性与经济可持续性之间的关系，以及经济可持续性与社会可持续性之间的关系，持续受到关注。我们分析了全球121个渔业的数据，以评估潜在的权衡。我们没有发现权衡的证据，反而发现在渔业得到管理的情况下，环境、经济和社会目标是互补的。我们的结果挑战了三大可持续性支柱相互冲突的观点，表明权利基础制度可以被设计为同时支持三大支柱。

The Fishery Performance Indicators: A Management Tool for Triple Bottom Line Outcomes
abstract: Pursuit of the triple bottom line of economic, community and ecological sustainability has increased the complexity of fishery management; fisheries assessments require new types of data and analysis to guide science-based policy in addition to traditional biological information and modeling. We introduce the Fishery Performance Indicators (FPIs), a broadly applicable and flexible tool for assessing performance in individual fisheries, and for establishing cross-sectional links between enabling conditions, management strategies and triple bottom line outcomes. Conceptually separating measures of performance, the FPIs use 68 individual outcome metrics--coded on a 1 to 5 scale based on expert assessment to facilitate application to data poor fisheries and sectors--that can be partitioned into sector-based or triple-bottom-line sustainability-based interpretative indicators. Variation among outcomes is explained with 54 similarly structured metrics of inputs, management approaches and enabling conditions. Using 61 initial fishery case studies drawn from industrial and developing countries around the world, we demonstrate the inferential importance of tracking economic and community outcomes, in addition to resource status.
abstract_zh: 追求经济、社区和生态三重底线的可持续性，增加了渔业管理的复杂性；渔业评估除了传统的生物信息和建模之外，还需要新型数据和分析，以指导基于科学的政策。我们提出了渔业绩效指标（FPI），这是一种适用范围广泛且灵活的工具，用于评估单个渔业的绩效，并建立有利条件、管理策略与三重底线结果之间的横截面联系。FPI将绩效衡量与其他方面区分开来，使用68项单独的结果指标——基于专家评估按1至5分编码，以便应用于数据匮乏的渔业和部门——这些指标可以被划分为基于部门的或基于三重底线可持续性的解释性指标。结果之间的差异则由54项结构相似的投入、管理方式和有利条件指标加以解释。利用来自工业化国家和发展中国家的61个初始渔业案例研究，我们证明了除资源状况之外，追踪经济和社区结果具有重要的推断意义。

The market potential for farmed freshwater finfish in Germany: A focus on catfish
abstract: Freshwater species account for approximately 15% of annual German per capita seafood consumption, and this number is expected to grow. Traditionally favoured freshwater species include rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), carp (Cyprinus caprio), and pike‐perch (Stizostedion spp.). Relative newcomers to the German market include Lake Victoria perch (Lates nilotcus) from Africa and channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) from the United States. This report utilises a conjoint analysis experiment, based on a survey of German seafood retailers, to evaluate the relative value of catfish attributes including size, product form, and country of origin. The results indicate that German retailers prefer larger fresh catfish than the 0.5–1.0 kg ‘pan sized’ products marketed domestically in the US This suggests a strategic export opportunity for US farmers, utilising the German market as a potential outlet for ‘over‐wintered’ fish that exceed optimal size for the US market.
abstract_zh: 淡水物种约占德国人均年海产品消费量的15%，且这一比例预计还将增长。传统上受青睐的淡水物种包括虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）、鲤鱼（Cyprinus caprio）和梭鲈（pike-perch，Stizostedion属）。德国市场上较新的成员包括来自非洲的维多利亚湖尼罗河鲈（Lates nilotcus）和来自美国的河鲶（channel catfish，Ictalurus punctatus）。本报告利用一项针对德国海产品零售商的调查所开展的联合分析实验，评估了鲶鱼的各项属性（包括规格、产品形态和原产国）的相对价值。结果表明，德国零售商更偏好较大的新鲜鲶鱼，而非美国国内市场销售的0.5至1.0公斤“平底锅大小”（pan sized）产品。这表明，美国农民可利用德国市场作为出口渠道，销售超过美国市场最优规格的“越冬”鱼，从而获得战略性出口机会。

title: Deseasonalized State-Space Time Series Forecasting with Application to the US Salmon Market
JOURNAL ARTICLE OF THE YEAR FOR 1994: AN ADAPTIVE MODEL OF PERISHABLE INVENTORY DISSIPATION IN A NONSTATIONARY PRICE ENVIRONMENT; ABSTRACT
An Adaptive Model of Perishable Inventory Dissipation in a Nonstationary Price Environment
abstract: The paper develops an adaptive model of perishable commodity dissipation based on the individual's price expectations and risk perception. A two-step, state-space procedure for modeling nonstationary time series is presented. The method combines an impulse response model for estimating deterministic components with an innovations model for the remaining stationary stochastic noise. Combined parameters are used to generate forecasts and to derive a measure of risk in a nonstationary price environment. Defined as the variance (covariance) of out-of-sample forecast error, the measure of risk is the difference between the historical estimate of the stationary noise auto-covariance and the variance (covariance) of out-of-sample forecasts. The optimal marketing strategy for a hypothetical salmon processor who sells to Japanese wholesalers is developed to illustrate the model. The solution is obtained using quadratic programming algorithm.
abstract_zh: 本文基于个体的价格预期和风险感知，建立了一个易腐商品消耗的适应性模型。提出了一种用于对非平稳时间序列建模的两步状态空间程序。该方法将用于估计确定性成分的脉冲响应模型与用于刻画剩余平稳随机噪声的新息模型相结合。组合后的参数用于生成预测，并在非平稳价格环境中推导出风险度量。风险度量被定义为样本外预测误差的方差（协方差），即历史估计的平稳噪声自协方差与样本外预测的方差（协方差）之差。为说明该模型，文章构建了一个假设的鲑鱼加工商的最优营销策略，该加工商向日本批发商出售产品。求解采用二次规划算法。
